title: Apple Inc. 8-K: Item 8.01 Other Events; Item 9.01 Financial Statements and Exhibits
text: Item 8.01 Other Events. On November 9, 2026, Apple Inc. (“Apple”) consummated the issuance and sale of $500,000,000 aggregate principal amount of its Floating Rate Notes due 2028 (the “2028 Floating Rate Notes”), $750,000,000 aggregate principal amount of its Floating Rate Notes due 2029 (the “2029 Floating Rate Notes”), $1,000,000,000 aggregate principal amount of its 4.650% Notes due 2028 (the “2028 Fixed Rate Notes”), $1,000,000,000 aggregate principal amount of its 4.750% Notes due 2029 (the “2029 Fixed Rate Notes”), $1,000,000,000 aggregate principal amount of its 4.900% Notes due 2031 (the “2031 Fixed Rate Notes”), $1,250,000,000 aggregate principal amount of its 5.100% Notes due 2033 (the “2033 Fixed Rate Notes”) and $2,000,000,000 aggregate principal amount of its 5.350% Notes due 2036 (the “2036 Fixed Rate Notes” and, together with the 2028 Floating Rate Notes, the 2029 Floating Rate Notes, the 2028 Fixed Rate Notes, the 2029 Fixed Rate Notes, the 2031 Fixed Rate Notes and the 2033 Fixed Rate Notes, the “Notes”), pursuant to an underwriting agreement (the “Underwriting Agreement”) dated November 5, 2026 among Apple and Goldman Sachs & Co. LLC, BofA Securities, Inc., Deutsche Bank Securities Inc. and J.P. Morgan Securities LLC, as representatives of the several underwriters named therein. The Notes are being issued pursuant to an indenture, dated as of November 1, 2024 (the “Indenture”), between Apple and The Bank of New York Mellon Trust Company, N.A., as trustee, together with the officer’s certificate, dated November 9, 2026 (the “Officer’s Certificate”), issued pursuant to the Indenture establishing the terms of each series of Notes. The Notes are being issued pursuant to Apple’s Registration Statement on Form S-3 filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission and dated November 1, 2024 (Reg. No. 333-282937) (the “Registration Statement”). Interest on the 2028 Floating Rate Notes and the 2029 Floating Rate Notes will be paid quarterly in arrears on February 9, May 9, August 9 and November 9 of each year, beginning on February 9, 2027. Interest on the 2028 Fixed Rate Notes, the 2029 Fixed Rate Notes, the 2031 Fixed Rate Notes, the 2033 Fixed Rate Notes, and the 2036 Fixed Rate Notes will be paid semi-annually in arrears on May 9 and November 9 of each year, beginning on May 9, 2027. The 2028 Floating Rate Notes will mature on November 9, 2028. The 2029 Floating Rate Notes will mature on November 9, 2029. The 2028 Fixed Rate Notes will mature on November 9, 2028. The 2029 Fixed Rate Notes will mature on November 9, 2029. The 2031 Fixed Rate Notes will mature on November 9, 2031. The 2033 Fixed Rate Notes will mature on November 9, 2033. The 2036 Fixed Rate Notes will mature on November 9, 2036. The Notes will be Apple’s senior unsecured obligations and will rank equally with Apple’s other unsecured and unsubordinated debt from time to time outstanding. The foregoing description of the Notes and related agreements is qualified in its entirety by the terms of the Underwriting Agreement, the Indenture and the Officer’s Certificate (including the forms of the Notes). Apple is furnishing the Underwriting Agreement and the Officer’s Certificate (including the forms of the Notes) attached hereto as Exhibits 1.1 and 4.1 through 4.8, respectively, and they are incorporated herein by reference. The Indenture is filed as Exhibit 4.1 to the Registration Statement. An opinion regarding the legality of the Notes is filed as Exhibit 5.1, and is incorporated by reference into the Registration Statement; and a consent relating to the incorporation of such opinion is incorporated by reference into the Registration Statement and is filed as Exhibit 23.1 by reference to its inclusion within Exhibit 5.1. title: Apple reportedly met with Thai officials over spyware alerts sent to politicians
text: Apple reportedly met with Thai officials over spyware alerts sent to politicians. Apple has met with Thai government officials in the wake of its recent wave of iPhone alerts about mercenary spyware attacks.

title: Trump Pushes for Nvidia to Hire Former Apple Chief Tim Cook to Replace Jensen Huang
text: Trump Pushes for Nvidia to Hire Former Apple Chief Tim Cook to Replace Jensen Huang. President Donald Trump on Thursday encouraged Nvidia to hire former Apple CEO Tim Cook to replace Jensen Huang after Huang resigned amid revelations of extramarital affairs, including one involving a woman believed to be a Chinese spy.

title: Apple to investigate accident that killed three workers at iPhone parts factory in India
text: Apple to investigate accident that killed three workers at iPhone parts factory in India. Reuters reports that three contract workers died after inhaling gas during an inspection at a Tata Electronics factory that produces iPhone components in India.
